traitor.goal: Awaken the ancient Mummy and sacrifice the explorers to complete your dark rebirth ritual.
rules: You control the Mummy during your turn.
The Mummy rolls 5 dice in Might attacks and cannot be permanently harmed by normal attacks.
Traitor wins when all heroes are slain or sacrificed.

heroes.goal: Decipher the ancient hieroglyphics and banish the Mummy with sacred incantations.
rules: Find the Book or Holy Symbol to cast banishment spells.
Make Knowledge rolls (target 5+) in the Crypt or sarcophagus room to seal it.
Heroes win when the sarcophagus is sealed or the Mummy is destroyed.

traitor.goal: Summon the Restless Spirit to consume the sanity of the living.
rules: The Spirit can pass through walls and moves at Speed 4.
Spirit attacks target Sanity rather than Might.
Traitor wins when all heroes die or succumb to complete madness.

heroes.goal: Find the spirit's mortal remains and lay them to rest in consecrated ground.
rules: Search the house for the Spirit Board and holy relics.
Bring relics to the Chapel or Pentagram Chamber.
Heroes win when the ritual of peace is performed.

traitor.goal: Brew the Witch's brew by tossing frogs and heroes into the bubbling cauldron.
rules: Feed ingredients and captured heroes into the cauldron in the Kitchen.
Traitor wins when the cauldron is fully stirred and boiled.

heroes.goal: Spill the cauldron, extinguish the cursed fire, and defeat the Witch.
rules: Make Might checks (target 5+) in the Kitchen to tip over the cauldron.
Heroes win when the cauldron is spilled or the Witch is slain.

traitor.goal: Trap the heroes in giant spider webs and feed the ravenous Broodmother.
rules: Giant spiders spin webs across doorways that cost 2 extra movement to cross.
Spiders make Speed-based attacks that paralyze victims.
Traitor wins when all heroes are webbed and devoured.

heroes.goal: Burn the web nests and slay the Broodmother.
rules: Find fire or weapons to clear webbed rooms.
Attack the Broodmother with Might rolls.
Heroes win when the Broodmother spider is destroyed.

traitor.goal: You have transformed into a ferocious Werewolf. Feast upon your former companions!
rules: Gain +2 Might and +2 Speed in wolf form.
You take damage only from the Spear or silver weapons.
Traitor wins when all heroes are slain.

heroes.goal: Forge a silver weapon or find the Spear to slay the ravenous beast.
rules: Search for the Spear or forge silver bullets/weapons in the Furnace Room.
Attack the Werewolf with silver to inflict mortal wounds.
Heroes win when the Werewolf is slain.

traitor.goal: Awaken the gigantic cosmic Eye from beyond the stars and stare the mortals into madness.
rules: The Floating Eye levitates through open doorways and floors.
The Eye makes Sanity gaze attacks across lines of sight.
Traitor wins when all heroes are dead or driven mad.

heroes.goal: Blind the cosmic horror by reflecting its hypnotic gaze back upon itself.
rules: Locate mirrors and bright light sources.
Make Knowledge or Sanity checks to aim the beam into the Eye.
Heroes win when the Eye is blinded and banished.

traitor.goal: Cultivate monstrous carnivorous vines to choke the mansion and digest the intruders.
rules: Vines spread one room each turn, blocking movement.
Explorers in vine-choked rooms take physical damage.
Traitor wins when vines conquer the house or heroes are digested.

heroes.goal: Synthesize weed-killer herbicide and destroy the central root bulb.
rules: Gather chemical components in the Research Lab or Conservatory.
Spray the root bulb in the Gardens or Conservatory.
Heroes win when the root bulb is eradicated.

traitor.goal: Complete the dark coven pact by summoning demonic familiars.
rules: Familiars hunt heroes and drain their life force.
Traitor gains bonus defense while inside the Pentagram Chamber.
Traitor wins when the ritual reaches full power.

heroes.goal: Disrupt the ritual circles and unbind the demonic pact.
rules: Collect candles and sacred salt throughout the rooms.
Disrupt ritual glyphs with Sanity/Knowledge rolls.
Heroes win when 3 ritual circles are cleansed.

traitor.goal: Play the bewitching music to force the heroes into a fatal, never-ending dance.
rules: Heroes who hear the music must make Sanity rolls or dance uncontrollably.
Dancing drains Speed and Might each turn.
Traitor wins when all explorers collapse from exhaustion.

heroes.goal: Find earplugs and smash the enchanted music box or organ.
rules: Make Knowledge checks to muffle the music.
Smash the enchanted instrument with Might rolls in the Ballroom.
Heroes win when the instrument is silenced forever.

traitor.goal: Drag the chosen hero into the shadow realm through the cursed mirrors.
rules: Travel instantaneously between rooms containing mirrors.
Phantom touch drains Knowledge and Sanity.
Traitor wins when the marked hero is pulled into the abyss.

heroes.goal: Shatter the cursed mirrors and banish the Phantom to the ether.
rules: Locate mirrors throughout the mansion.
Roll Might 4+ to shatter each mirror.
Heroes win when all 4 mirrors are destroyed.

traitor.goal: Unleash a ravenous, ever-growing gelatinous blob that dissolves everything.
rules: The Blob expands into adjacent rooms each round.
Explorers touched by the Blob suffer severe acid damage.
Traitor wins when the mansion is consumed.

heroes.goal: Freeze the gelatinous horror or blow it to pieces with explosives.
rules: Find coolant chemicals or fire extinguishers.
Expose the Blob to extreme cold or detonation.
Heroes win when the core of the Blob freezes and shatters.

traitor.goal: Use Medusa's ancient gaze to turn all living intruders into eternal stone statues.
rules: Petrifying gaze forces explorers to make Might saves or lose Speed.
When Speed hits 0, the hero becomes permanently petrified.
Traitor wins when all heroes become statues.

heroes.goal: Use polished shields and mirrors to reflect the Gorgon's petrifying gaze.
rules: Find reflective surfaces or shields.
Corner the Gorgon and reflect its gaze with a Might/Speed roll.
Heroes win when the Gorgon petrifies itself or is beheaded.

traitor.goal: Raise a horde of flesh-eating zombies from the graveyard and overrun the mansion.
rules: Spawn 2 zombies each turn from the Graveyard and Crypt.
Zombies attack with Might 4 and can grab explorers.
Traitor wins when all heroes are eaten.

heroes.goal: Board up windows and doorways, then incinerate the zombie source.
rules: Barricade rooms using wood planks.
Find kerosene and torches to burn the zombie nests.
Heroes win when the master corpse is burned.

traitor.goal: Reanimate the Frankenstein monster with lightning and command it to crush the intruders.
rules: The Creature has Might 7 and cannot be stunned easily.
Traitor channels laboratory power to energize the beast.
Traitor wins when all heroes are crushed.

heroes.goal: Short-circuit the lightning generators and de-activate the monster.
rules: Cut circuit cables in the Operating Laboratory or Furnace Room.
Make Knowledge checks to reverse the electrical flow.
Heroes win when the generators explode, neutralizing the creature.

traitor.goal: Hatch the great Dragon in the subterranean depths and incinerate the mansion.
rules: The Dragon breathes fire that damages entire rooms.
The Dragon is armored against ordinary blows.
Traitor wins when heroes are reduced to ashes.

heroes.goal: Find the legendary Dragonbane weapon and pierce the beast's weak underbelly.
rules: Search the Armory and Vault for the sacred spear or heavy ballista.
Roll Might/Speed to strike the single missing scale.
Heroes win when the Dragon collapses.

traitor.goal: Entomb an explorer alive beneath the foundation before the air runs out.
rules: A buried victim loses 1 Sanity or Might each turn they remain trapped.
Traitor defends the burial site with traps and weapons.
Traitor wins if the buried victim suffocates.

heroes.goal: Locate the hidden grave and dig out the trapped companion before it is too late.
rules: Follow acoustic clues to find the buried coffin.
Make Might checks to dig through the rubble and pry open the lid.
Heroes win when the trapped explorer is rescued.

traitor.goal: A ghostly Phantom terrorizes the opera halls and corridors, demanding absolute obedience.
rules: The Phantom vanishes into thin air when struck, reappearing in darkness.
Traitor cuts lights to plunge the mansion into blackness.
Traitor wins when all heroes are eliminated.

heroes.goal: Illuminate the house and rip off the Phantom's mask to break the curse.
rules: Restore lighting and light chandeliers across the house.
Corner the Phantom in a bright room and make a Might check.
Heroes win when the mask is removed.

traitor.goal: Command a swarm of diseased plague rats to overwhelm and infect the house.
rules: Rat swarms move quickly and deal plague poison damage.
Plagued heroes lose 1 Might at the start of each turn.
Traitor wins when all heroes succumb to the Black Death.

heroes.goal: Synthesize an antidote and exterminate King Rat.
rules: Find antidote herbs in the Larder or Conservatory.
Administer cure to diseased companions.
Slay King Rat with Might or fire attacks.

haunts.name: A Friend for the End of the World

traitor.goal: There is no traitor! The house is collapsing into an interdimensional vortex.
rules: Every round, rooms fall into the void.
All players must work together to escape.

heroes.goal: Find the dimensional anchor and stabilize the reality rip before everyone falls into oblivion.
rules: Assemble 3 stabilization runes from disparate floors.
Activate the dimensional anchor in the Entrance Hall.
All living explorers win by escaping through the front doors.

traitor.goal: Force a living explorer into an eternal spectral marriage in the Chapel.
rules: The Ghost Bride entrances heroes with wedding music.
Traitor drags the groom/bride toward the altar.
Traitor wins when the unholy wedding vows are completed.

heroes.goal: Find the lost wedding ring and return it to the true grave to lay the bride to rest.
rules: Search the master bedroom and vaults for the lost heirloom.
Carry the heirloom to the crypt and recite the funeral rite.
Heroes win when the Ghost Bride finds peace.

traitor.goal: Attach puppet strings to the explorers and make them slaughter one another.
rules: Control an explorer's movements with puppet strings each turn.
Puppet Master stays hidden in the secret workshop.
Traitor wins when the puppet show leaves no survivors.

heroes.goal: Cut the puppet strings and burn the Puppet Master's workshop.
rules: Use sharp blades to sever strings attached to companions.
Locate the Puppet Master's workshop and burn the marionettes.
Heroes win when the master strings are severed.

traitor.goal: Open the Abyssal Portal in the basement to consume reality.
rules: Dark tendrils erupt from cracks in the floor.
Sanity rolls required to look at the portal.
Traitor wins when the portal opens completely.

heroes.goal: Collect celestial runes to seal the Abyssal Rift.
rules: Find runes in the Attic, Chapel, and Library.
Place runes on the boundary of the Chasm or Pentagram Chamber.
Heroes win when the rift is permanently sealed.

traitor.goal: Awaken the subterranean kraken whose giant tentacles smash through the floors.
rules: Tentacles spawn in 4 different rooms and crush intruders.
Tentacles can grab explorers and squeeze them for Might damage.
Traitor wins when all heroes are pulled under.

heroes.goal: Sever the tentacles and poison the central beast.
rules: Attack tentacles with weapons (target 4+ Might to sever).
Dump toxic chemicals down the well or coal chute.
Heroes win when all active tentacles are severed.

traitor.goal: Summon a swarm of mutated killer bats that blot out the sky.
rules: Bat swarms blind explorers and attack from above.
Bats heal the traitor when they feed on heroes.
Traitor wins when all heroes are drained of blood.

heroes.goal: Assemble high-frequency sonic emitters to disperse the swarm.
rules: Find electronic tubes and radio components in the attic.
Build the sonic whistle in the Workshop or Tower.
Heroes win when the sonic pulse drives the swarm away.

traitor.goal: Craft voodoo dolls representing each explorer and torture them from afar.
rules: Traitor inflicts damage by stabbing needles into dolls.
Traitor stays protected by voodoo warding totems.
Traitor wins when all explorer dolls are destroyed.

heroes.goal: Sneak into the witch doctor's lair and recover your personal effigies.
rules: Search the traitor's sanctum for the voodoo dolls.
Cleanse dolls with holy water from the Chapel.
Heroes win when all dolls are retrieved and purified.

traitor.goal: Play the Pied Piper's flute to lure explorers into the bottomless pit.
rules: Charmed heroes are forced to walk toward the Chasm each round.
Traitor moves at high speed and cannot be intercepted easily.
Traitor wins when all heroes plunge into the chasm.

heroes.goal: Deafen yourselves or snap the enchanted pipe.
rules: Stuff ears with wax or cloth to resist the tune.
Ambush the Piper and disarm the flute.
Heroes win when the flute is broken in half.

traitor.goal: A psychotic frenzy overtakes you. Slay everyone in sight with a blood-soaked axe!
rules: Gain +3 Might and immunity to fear effects.
Cleave attack hits multiple heroes in the same room.
Traitor wins when no heroes draw breath.

heroes.goal: Set a cunning trap or lure the madman into a reinforced cage.
rules: Construct a snare trap in the Kitchen or Basement.
Lure the berserker into the trap with Speed rolls.
Heroes win when the berserker is trapped and neutralized.

traitor.goal: Ignite magical hellfire that spreads from room to room, trapping the mortals.
rules: Fire spreads to 1 adjacent room every round.
Entering or ending a turn in a burning room deals fire damage.
Traitor wins when the house burns down with heroes inside.

heroes.goal: Activate the house sprinkler system or breach the water cistern.
rules: Reach the water valve in the Basement or Boiler Room.
Make Might checks to turn the rusted iron wheel.
Heroes win when the deluge extinguishes the inferno.

traitor.goal: Harvest vital organs from the explorers to build the ultimate resurrected monstrosity.
rules: Harvested organs grant permanent stat boosts to the Traitor.
Summon reanimated flesh-golems to pin down victims.
Traitor wins when the masterwork is completed.

heroes.goal: Destroy the preservation vats and destroy the surgical notes.
rules: Smash glass vats in the Operating Laboratory.
Burn the anatomical manuscripts in the Furnace.
Heroes win when the lab is ruined and the monster dismantled.

traitor.goal: Awaken Count Dracula from his stone crypt and offer the explorers as his blood banquet.
rules: Dracula turns into mist to move freely across floors.
Dracula bites victims to drain Might and turn them into thralls.
Traitor wins when all heroes are converted or bled dry.

heroes.goal: Carve wooden stakes, find garlic, and drive a stake through Dracula's heart.
rules: Find wooden furniture and fashion stakes with a knife.
Corner Dracula in his coffin in the Crypt or Vault.
Roll Might 5+ to drive the stake home and slay the vampire king.

traitor.goal: There is no traitor! The entire mansion has detached from earth and is flying into a storm!
rules: Violent turbulence throws explorers across rooms.
Rooms periodically break off into the clouds.
All players must cooperate to bring the house down safely.

heroes.goal: Reach the attic pilot controls and deploy parachutes or land the mansion.
rules: Navigate the collapsing upper floor against gale winds.
Make Knowledge checks to calibrate the altitude levers.
Heroes win when the house touches down safely.

traitor.goal: Shift the architectural geometry of the house into an infinite, shifting labyrinth.
rules: Scramble room connections and trap doors.
Minotaurs stalk the labyrinth corridors.
Traitor wins when explorers starve in the maze.

heroes.goal: Map the shifting walls and discover the golden key to the true exit.
rules: Leave breadcrumb markers in discovered rooms.
Make Knowledge checks to deduce the true center of the maze.
Heroes win when they unlock the grand exit door.

traitor.goal: Command phantom apparitions that manifest the worst nightmares of each explorer.
rules: Apparitions attack the specific lowest trait of each hero.
Apparitions cannot be touched by physical weapons.
Traitor wins when all heroes perish in sheer terror.

heroes.goal: Overcome personal phobias and light the sanctuary beacon.
rules: Make Sanity rolls to face down spectral apparitions.
Light the consecrated incense burners in the Chapel.
Heroes win when the light banishes the nightmare mist.

traitor.goal: You are infected by an extraterrestrial spore. Infect the rest of humanity!
rules: Spore attacks transmit alien infection.
Infected heroes turn into alien thralls upon death.
Traitor wins when all explorers are assimilated.

heroes.goal: Sterilize the alien spore pods with concentrated ultraviolet radiation.
rules: Assemble UV spotlights in the Laboratory or Tower.
Burn the alien hive cluster before spores burst.
Heroes win when the star spores are completely eradicated.

traitor.goal: Shrink the explorers to the size of insects with an arcane shrink ray.
rules: Tiny explorers move 1 room per turn and take double damage.
Traitor's pet cat and mice become colossal predators.
Traitor wins when the tiny pests are squashed.

heroes.goal: Climb the laboratory table and reverse the polarity of the shrink ray.
rules: Scale chair legs and ropes using Speed rolls.
Rewire the shrink ray capacitors with Knowledge rolls.
Heroes win when they restore their normal size and capture the traitor.

traitor.goal: Feed the legendary Hog of Calydon until it grows large enough to devour the world.
rules: The Giant Hog rams through walls, creating new openings.
Hog charge inflicts massive crushing Might damage.
Traitor wins when the Hog consumes all explorers.

heroes.goal: Craft an irresistible bait trap and lure the boar into the incinerator.
rules: Gather truffles and food supplies from the Kitchen.
Lure the beast into the Furnace Room with bait.
Heroes win when the great hog is trapped in the furnace.

traitor.goal: Trap the heroes in a life-sized chess duel where every captured piece is an execution.
rules: Floor tiles turn into black and white chessboard squares.
Traitor moves animated stone knights and rooks.
Traitor wins when the Hero King is checkmated.

heroes.goal: Outmaneuver the animated chess pieces and capture the Traitor's Queen.
rules: Move according to chessboard movement rules.
Make Knowledge checks to formulate winning gambits.
Heroes win when the opposing King/Queen is cornered and struck down.

traitor.goal: You are the true heir of this cursed estate. Eliminate the witnesses to claim your dark inheritance.
rules: You possess master keys to all secret doors and trapdoors.
Family ghosts aid you in tracking intruders.
Traitor wins when all trespassers are eliminated.

heroes.goal: Find the true last will and testament proving the traitor is an imposter.
rules: Search the master safe in the Library or Vault.
Crack the safe combination with Knowledge rolls.
Heroes win when the true will is revealed and the imposter stripped of power.

traitor.goal: No traitor! A sealed cursed chamber has opened, releasing ancient miasma.
rules: Poisonous fumes leak into the house floor by floor.
All players take toxic gas damage unless filtered.

heroes.goal: Find the missing keystones and re-seal the vault before the poisonous gas suffocates everyone.
rules: Locate 3 heavy stone keystones hidden across the floors.
Carry keystones to the hidden room entrance.
Heroes win when the cursed doorway is cemented shut.

traitor.goal: Awaken the amphibious Gill-Man from the submerged basement caverns.
rules: Basement flooded with dark murky water.
Gill-Man drags victims underwater to drown them.
Traitor wins when all heroes drown.

heroes.goal: Pump out the flood water and electrocute the amphibian monster.
rules: Start the emergency drainage pump in the Boiler Room.
Rig electrical cables into the standing water.
Heroes win when the aquatic creature is shocked into submission.

traitor.goal: Serve a lavish banquet poisoned with cursed flesh to turn guests into cannibals.
rules: Tempted heroes must make Sanity checks or eat the cursed food.
Cannibal heroes switch sides to join the traitor.
Traitor wins when all heroes partake or die.

heroes.goal: Destroy the poisoned banquet table and administer emetics to infected friends.
rules: Overturn the banquet table in the Dining Room with Might checks.
Brew medicinal charcoal antidotes in the Kitchen.
Heroes win when the cursed feast is ruined and survivors saved.

traitor.goal: Summon the World Serpent beneath the foundation to swallow time itself.
rules: The giant worm body loops through rooms, crushing doors.
Time loops cause previous turn events to repeat.
Traitor wins when the serpent swallows its tail.

heroes.goal: Sever the ouroboros loop with an ancient temporal blade.
rules: Find the chronal dagger in the Gallery or Vault.
Strike the serpent's junction node with precise timing.
Heroes win when the cosmic loop breaks and the worm dissolves.

traitor.goal: Summon the clockwork automaton 'Albert' to mechanically purge all organic life.
rules: Albert possesses heavy steel plating and piston-driven strikes.
Steam valves vent scalding clouds that obscure vision.
Traitor wins when all flesh is eliminated.

heroes.goal: Jam Albert's internal brass gear train with crowbars and wrenches.
rules: Find heavy metal tools in the Workshop.
Make Speed checks to dodge steam and insert gears.
Heroes win when Albert's mainspring snaps.

traitor.goal: Animate an indestructible clay Golem with an ancient Hebrew parchment scroll.
rules: The Golem ignores normal weapon attacks completely.
Golem punches destroy barriers and inflict crushing wounds.
Traitor wins when the intruders are battered to dust.

heroes.goal: Erase the sacred letter 'Emet' (Truth) on the Golem's forehead to turn it to 'Met' (Death).
rules: Climb the Golem or distract it with bright mirrors.
Make a delicate Speed or Knowledge check to wipe the clay letter.
Heroes win when the Golem collapses into harmless mud.

traitor.goal: No traitor! A crimson sentient mist creeps in through broken windows.
rules: The Evil Fog dissolves the skin of anyone caught within it.
The Fog expands each round from the Ground floor.

heroes.goal: Seal all exterior vents and power up the furnace blowers to vent the fog outside.
rules: Board up broken windows on the ground floor.
Stoke the coal furnace to create positive air pressure.
Heroes win when the toxic fog is expelled from the house.

traitor.goal: Bleed the house walls until the rooms fill with a lake of blood.
rules: Rooms flood with blood, reducing movement and vision.
Blood leech swarms latch onto heroes.
Traitor wins when the mansion sinks into the crimson tide.

heroes.goal: Open the drainage spillways and consecrate the source.
rules: Locate emergency drainage valves in the Basement.
Drop holy salt into the wellspring to purify the liquid.
Heroes win when the blood drains away.

traitor.goal: Release carnivorous burrowing worms that erupt through floorboards.
rules: Worms burrow under floor tiles, leaving sinkholes behind.
Worm bites inject neurotoxins that paralyze heroes.
Traitor wins when all explorers are dragged subterranean.

heroes.goal: Electrify the floor grids or deploy sound thumper lures.
rules: Set up rhythmic thumpers to confuse the worms.
Shock the soil with generator cables.
Heroes win when the subterranean swarm retreats.

traitor.goal: A masked slasher stalks the mansion with a chainsaw. Stack their bodies in the shed!
rules: Slasher moves fast and is relentless.
Chainsaw attacks cleave through doors and flesh.
Traitor wins when all heroes are stacked in the meat locker.

heroes.goal: Find weapons, set an ambush, and unmask the psychotic slasher.
rules: Arm yourselves with axes, guns, or heavy furniture.
Ambush the killer in a dead-end corridor with coordinated rolls.
Heroes win when the slasher is defeated once and for all.

traitor.goal: You are a shapeshifting skin-thief. Steal the identities and faces of the explorers!
rules: Skin-thief can disguise themselves as any living player.
Surprise backstab attacks deal devastating stealth damage.
Traitor wins when all true explorers are replaced by skins.

heroes.goal: Devise a secret passphrase or blood test to unmask the shapeshifting imposter.
rules: Establish private code words between confirmed players.
Test blood samples with hot wire in the Laboratory.
Heroes win when the true skin-walker is identified and destroyed.

traitor.goal: There is no traitor! A hidden pirate hoard has been uncovered, but greedy spirits protect it.
rules: Ghost pirates defend the treasure chests with spectral cutlasses.
Explorers compete or cooperate to secure the loot and escape.

heroes.goal: Crack the secret vault chests, defeat the ghost pirates, and escape with the gold!
rules: Pick the iron chest locks with Knowledge/Speed rolls.
Defend against waves of ghostly buccaneers.
All surviving explorers win by carrying the treasure out the front door.
